name: Probanda_Legal_experimental
description: Probanda, Claude Cowork plugins for legal practice in British Columbia

plugins.name: lawyer
plugins.description: The core plugin: firm records, time, billing, case data and deadlines, and skills for any lawyer (restate a request before acting, summarize a session). Requires nothing. Install it first: every other Probanda plugin requires it.

plugins.name: researcher
plugins.description: What the law is: legal research, citation and verification. Requires lawyer. Install lawyer first, then researcher.

plugins.name: litigator
plugins.description: Court work on a matter: applying the law to the facts, drafting, court forms and filing packages. Requires lawyer and researcher. Install lawyer, then researcher, then litigator.

plugins.name: solicitor
plugins.description: Reserved for solicitor's work. Ships no skills yet. Requires lawyer. Install lawyer first.

plugins.name: file-manager
plugins.description: Optional. Every Probanda tool that renames, moves, changes or deletes files on your computer that Probanda did not create: matter housekeeping, routing accounting files, applying approved renames. Without it, Probanda only reads or copies those files. Requires lawyer. Install lawyer first, then file-manager.

plugins.name: billing
plugins.description: Optional. Time tracking and billing: gathers the evidence of a day's work, sorts it to client matters, corrects TimeCamp, drafts time entries, bills matters, records and reviews invoices, and follows up what clients owe. Requires lawyer. Install lawyer first, then billing.

plugins.name: developer
plugins.description: Maintainer-only, never public. Tools for developing Probanda: viewing and triaging the Suggestion Box, run from the probanda-dev checkout. Requires lawyer. Install lawyer first, then developer.

plugins.name: tokeneconomizer
plugins.description: Token Economizer, by Microsoft (https://github.com/microsoft/TokenEconomizer). Third-party, not part of Probanda. The original Microsoft TokenEconomizer was optimized for Claude Code. This version is adapted for Claude Cowork. Micro-skills learned per repository and a failure-loop guard. Tool pruning is off in this version. Requires Python 3.10 or newer. Requires no other plugin.
